title: Multi-Tab WebSocket Storm vs Leader-Elected Backpressure
description: Trace how 8 open tabs amplify a 400 msg/s burst into main-thread stalls and reconnect storms, and how Web Locks + Worker Streams + Full Jitter isolate it.

steps.label: 1. Naive 8-Tab Fan-Out
steps.description: Each tab opens its own WebSocket. At 10k active users with 8 tabs each, the gateway holds 80,000 concurrent sockets.
steps.codeHighlight: const ws = new WebSocket('wss://rt.example.com/feed'); // x8 per browser

steps.label: 2. 400 msg/s Burst & Main-Thread Freeze
steps.description: All 8 tabs parse identical JSON payloads on the main thread, spiking INP past 1,800 ms and stalling TransformStream readers.

steps.label: 3. Gateway Drop & Reconnect Storm
steps.description: Fixed 1,000 ms retry timers fire in lockstep across 80,000 sockets, saturating TLS handshakes and keeping the gateway down.

steps.label: 4. Leader Lock + Worker Stream + Full Jitter
steps.description: Web Locks elect 1 leader tab; a Dedicated Worker parses frames behind a bounded TransformStream and fans out snapshots over BroadcastChannel.
